answer: Because the pearl solution is checked at the quartz gate and logged, the wharf audit can see the total work and a pre-solved puzzle is rejected as stale. Every submission must solve a hashcash puzzle with 26 leading zero bits before it is accepted, which prices volume directly. An operator emitting thousands of answers per epoch therefore burns the puzzle cost on each, while an honest agent solves a handful. That is 31 dollars per alias. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
